name: ue-perfectworld
description: Evidence-driven Unreal Engine workflows with S0-S6 checkpoints, conservative bounded implementation, runtime-aware parallel work, independent review, and verified delivery.

interface.shortDescription: UE 项目的证据驱动工作流：保守实现、授权内连续推进、并行协作与独立审查。
interface.longDescription: UE PerfectWorld retains S0-S6 as evidence checkpoints for requirements, project evidence, compact scope and specification, implementation, verification, independent review, and delivery. A clear implementation or fix request authorizes bounded edits after the scope is stated, allowing checkpoints to be combined and completed in one authorized turn. Planning, diagnosis, review, and no-edit requests remain read-only. Prefer reuse, configuration, and local fixes before new mechanisms. Substantial separable work uses runtime-aware parallel agents with one writer per file or asset; findings can be fixed within scope, verified, and independently reviewed on the latest integrated version. Setup initialization configures and verifies a default ceiling of 12 spawned agents while inspection-only requests remain read-only; saved configuration does not prove current runtime capacity. Pause for unresolved decisions, expanded scope, or separately unauthorized build, external, or version-control actions. Never commit or push automatically.
defaultPrompt: 用 UE PerfectWorld 规划这个 Unreal Engine 功能
用 UE PerfectWorld 排查这个 UE bug 的根因
用 UE PerfectWorld 审查当前 UE 代码
